item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Hypsope #8302 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Hypsope #8302 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.

item.title: Broken, not dead: Hypsope #8302 (the stone in their midst (House of Echion)). The Reapers
item.description: Broken, not dead: Hypsope #8302 (the stone in their midst (House of Echion)). The Reapers carry the pieces to Asphodel.

item.description: Antimippos #6625 the Blood-handed fell at Kallos #604's feet and clasped their knees, as Priam clasped Achilles'. Kallos #604 raised them up. The blood between them is set aside.

item.title: Kledotos #7570 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel
item.description: Kledotos #7570 was broken in the archipelago (brawl). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
